Changelog: Version 2.4.0 was released on 2024-10-20. This release added dark mode 
support across all screens. It fixed a login bug that prevented some users from authenticating. 
The legacy API was deprecated and will be removed in 3.0. It requires Python 3.10 or newer. 
Other changes include performance improvements, updated dependencies, and minor UI polish. 
The test suite was expanded. Documentation was refreshed. Security patches were applied. 
Migration notes are available in the docs folder. Users on older Python versions should 
upgrade before installing. Dark mode can be toggled in settings. The login fix addresses 
an issue with session tokens expiring early.

Summarize in at most 60 words. Include these facts: version 2.4.0, dark mode, login bug, legacy API, Python 3.10.
